capex_override.reason: Capex is missing in EDGAR companyfacts for FY2025 because the filer reported no investing cash flows at all in FY2025; the filing's cash-flow reconciliation proves the amount is $0, not an undisclosed purchase. Same presentation in the FY2024 comparative column, where the engine's last filed capex value is also $0, so a $0 override is in-band.
capex_override.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, filed 2026-03-24, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (p. F-7) and MD&A cash-flow summary: the statement presents no investing-activities section and no purchases of property and equipment line; net cash used in operating activities -$157,240 thousand plus net cash provided by financing activities $140,712 thousand plus FX effect $1,045 thousand equals the reported net decrease in cash -$15,483 thousand, confirming investing cash flow / capex was $0 for FY2025

moat_against: Active molecule is a known natural compound — moat covers formulation/protocol, not the molecule
Differentiated rivals can route around it (shorter-session compounds, e.g. Lilly/AtaiBeckley and AbbVie/Gilgamesh programs)
No pricing power demonstrated — no approved product, no payer contracts; supervised multi-hour session reimbursement unproven
Delivery model is a structural cost disadvantage vs daily oral drugs — certified site + monitored session per dose
Schedule I status — DEA and state rescheduling sit between FDA approval and revenue
moat_for: First-mover / only late-stage psilocybin program — two positive Phase 3 TRD trials
Breakthrough Therapy designation + Commissioner's National Priority Review voucher; rolling NDA already in review
Patent estate on synthetic COMP360 formulation, manufacture and use, plus regulatory exclusivity if approved
Trained-site / delivery-network know-how overlapping interventional-psychiatry infrastructure
moat_justification: Weak and approval-contingent: first-mover lead in psilocybin therapy (two positive Phase 3 TRD trials, Breakthrough Therapy designation, Commissioner's National Priority Review voucher, rolling NDA underway) plus formulation/use patents and site-network know-how, but the active molecule is a known natural compound competitors can route around (shorter-session compounds from Lilly/AtaiBeckley, AbbVie/Gilgamesh, Definium), no pricing power or payer coverage is proven, functional unblinding is a live criticism, and Schedule I rescheduling sits between approval and revenue.
name: COMPASS Pathways plc
one_liner: Pre-revenue single-asset psychedelic biotech, moat 3/10 contingent on approval — owner's earnings are negative in all 7 years of history (TTM -$1.42/share) despite two positive Phase 3 TRD trials and a rolling NDA, so it cannot clear the 15% hurdle at any price on an OE DCF; the $11.42 price is an FDA-approval option, not an earnings stream.
